_comment: Drift guard for the co-dependent lotSelector.ts / equityFunding.ts / lotDivest.ts set (RSU-lot-order spec, docs/tools/rsu-lot-order-spec.md §2.4). What it enforces: editing any of these three without regenerating this manifest fails mirror-manifest.test.ts in the SAME repo (file hash != recorded hash), so the manifest is forced to move in lockstep with the pair in every PR that touches them. Sync rule: copy all three (both files + this manifest) into the other repo together. LIMIT: this is a within-repo staleness check, not a cross-repo equality proof — if an edit in one repo is never propagated (both file AND manifest left stale on the other side), each repo stays internally green while drifting. Closing that fully needs a cross-repo assertion (CI fetching the other repo at a pinned ref); until then cross-repo identity rests on the sync PR touching both repos. Regenerate: node scripts/gen-calc-mirror-manifest.mjs. Other lib/calc files are intentionally NOT covered — several already diverge between repos.
